intent_snapshot.goal: Support optional top-level git_integration in user configuration (~/.config/immune-brain/config.json) with precedence user -> project -> legacy -> default under docs/specs/user-git-integration.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-DEC-1; meet BR-DEC-2, BR-DEC-3, BR-OUT-1, and BR-SCN-1..3 in docs/specs/user-git-integration.spec.md: resolveConfig and imm-kernel config --json accept optional top-level git_integration (manual|auto) in immune_brain/user_config/v1 with precedence user -> project -> legacy -> default (manual), reject projects.<key>.git_integration as unknown key, fail git_integration closed to manual on invalid user.git_integration or malformed/wrong-contract user file even when project sets auto, ignore untracked .imm/config.json, and emit legacy_source_ignored when user or project sets git_integration.

Source BR-REQ-1; meet BR-DEC-3, BR-DEC-4, and BR-SCN-1..3 in docs/specs/user-git-integration.spec.md: readGitIntegrationPreference and projectTaskStatus report user-resolved mode with config.files.user as status.git_integration.source (and status.config.git_integration.source === "user"), preserve .imm/config.json / AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / null when user omits git_integration, and fail closed to mode manual with invalid_git_integration and config_invalid warnings naming config.files.user on invalid user.git_integration, projects.<key>.git_integration, or malformed user file even when project sets auto.

Source BR-REQ-2 in docs/specs/user-git-integration.spec.md: docs/reference/immune-brain-config.md, docs/adr/0034-layered-configuration.md, and plugins/immune-brain/BASELINE.md document top-level user git_integration and user -> project -> default precedence; .changeset/user-git-integration.md is present; generated doc/BASELINE mirrors, Claude MCP bundle, and Antigravity plugin outputs pass sync-dist-docs.ts --check, build-claude-plugin.ts --check, build-antigravity-plugin.ts --check, and the contract tests.

attestations.summary: Provenance checked: b2ca7db's only parent is 77e763a and its tree is 2a294be. AC1: resolveConfig resolves user->project->legacy->default, fails git_integration closed to manual when the user file is invalid or user_file fails, keeps projects.<key>.git_integration an unknown key, and emits legacy_source_ignored when user or project sets the value. AC2: readGitIntegrationPreference's error matcher fails closed on exactly the cases where resolveConfig fails user_file or git_integration (lanes.active unknown_profile and per-project decision_models/lanes errors stay excluded) and reports config.files.user as source. AC3: docs, ADR and changeset are present, and the BASELINE copies, dist docs and Antigravity runtime have the same blob OIDs as their sources. Tests assert BR-SCN-1..3 through resolveConfig, imm-kernel config --json, readGitIntegrationPreference and projectTaskStatus. Blast radius: medium; the load-bearing paths are runtime/config/layered_config.ts, runtime/git_integration_preference.ts and the two MCP bundles; no persisted shape changes.
